_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'Stakeholder Register' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-03.04.

f01_ID.label: ID
f01_ID.guidance: Unique identifier for the stakeholder (e.g., SH-01).

f02_Name.label: Name
f02_Name.guidance: Stakeholder’s name. If unknown, specify the position or organization.

f03_Position_Role.label: Position/Role
f03_Position_Role.guidance: The position or functional role the stakeholder holds in the organization or project.

f04_Contact_information.label: Contact information
f04_Contact_information.guidance: Communication channels for the stakeholder such as email address or phone number.

f05_Requirements.label: Requirements
f05_Requirements.guidance: High-level needs and critical requirements for the project and deliverables.

f06_Expectations.label: Expectations
f06_Expectations.guidance: Main expectations regarding project execution, outcomes, and governance.
